answer: Harriet Vanger was not killed; she disappeared on September 24, 1966, and was presumed dead until it was revealed years later that she had escaped her uncle Gottfried Vanger's captivity and was alive [E1]. The official account stated that Harriet vanished from Hedeby Island after being last seen by Pastor Otto Falk, with the bridge blocked by an accident preventing anyone from leaving or entering [E2]. It was later discovered that Gottfried Vanger had raped Harriet and held her captive in his cabin on the island before he drowned in 1965, allowing her to escape [E3]. Martin Vanger did not kill Harriet but murdered other women with similar appearances to frame their nephew Henrik for the crimes [E4].
